=Build Process=

How to build plugins manually:

   # Make sure that you don't have any special characters in your Eclipse installation    path (this includes whitespaces)>confirmed on MacOS running Ganymede RC2.
   # Select "Export" from the context menu of your plugin.
   # Select "Plugin Development">"Deployable plugins and fragments".
   # Follow the steps on the wizard.
<br>
